articles.title: Trump's crypto riches loom over Clarity Act talks to ban conflicts for U.S. officials
articles.snippet: Discussion among Democrats have fixed on the president's personal gains when hashing out the crypto market structure bill's ethics provision.

articles.title: Profit-taking, MidEast hostilities drag crypto lower after bullish week
articles.snippet: Crypto's weekend gains gave way to a Monday selloff as Middle East tensions resurfaced, South Korea's Kospi lost 9.2% and $253 million in leveraged positions were wiped out.

articles.title: Bitcoin holds near $63,800 as war-driven selloff hits everything but crypto
articles.snippet: Gold, oil, stocks and bonds all moved sharply on the fourth round of U.S. strikes on Iran, but bitcoin is little-changed.

articles.title: Japan’s SBI to launch yen stablecoin lending with 3% yield
articles.snippet: SBI VC Trade will open JPYSC lending applications on July 16, offering an initial 3% annual rate for a 12-week term without deposit insurance.

articles.title: Bank of Thailand targets USDT and cash flows in gray money crackdown
articles.snippet: Thailand has been plagued by Chinese-affiliated scam centers, with illicit gains flowing through a “gray money” economy.
